unavailable_or_unclassified: This controls the endpoint invariant law, not ordinary-clock occupation, arbitrary/calibration-conditioned initialization, convergence, rapid mixing, iid output or erased retained memory. Unique-law mean optimality needs its uniqueness premise. Ordinary endpoint thinning has the SAME stationary mean; the cap is the distinction. Rational weights bound native calls, while bounded fair-bit time is licensed only in the stated dyadic cases. Real laboratory time, sensing, isolation, selector error and finite-data warrants remain separate.
